notes:
## Changes
- Duplicate scenes compares the copies side by side: folder, picture, size, rating, plays and drive, with the better value in green and a line saying why one copy is kept. "Keep this one" swaps which copy stays, and "Delete the spare" deletes the others (you're asked first; the copy kept is never touched).
- Duplicate scenes only looks at connected drives, as only they can be deleted from. The window opens smaller.
- Inside a folder, scene tiles no longer repeat the folder's name (the drive badge stays). All scenes, Home and lists still show it.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
